title: Blue-field entoptic phenomenon -> TRUMP contrastive witness exposure

phenomenon.user_observation: Many tiny bright points become noticeable against a bright blue field when external visual fixation is relaxed; this is phenomenologically more consistent with blue-field entoptic corpuscles than with slow vitreous floaters.
phenomenon.diagnostic_firewall: This record is a mechanism/representation note, not a medical diagnosis of any individual.

evidence.mechanism: Blue illumination near 430 nm creates differential optical contrast in retinal microvasculature: erythrocyte-rich blood strongly attenuates blue light while leukocytes and associated plasma gaps can appear as moving bright corpuscles. Experimental work supports leukocytes moving in macular/perimacular retinal microvasculature as the cellular source of the observed particles.

primary_sources.claim: Microvascular preparations under 430 nm illumination reproduced bright moving particles; morphology/staining supported leukocytes as the source and strongly suggested the same source in the human blue-field entoptic phenomenon.
Blue-field entoptic observation was used to perceive leukocyte motion in retinal macular capillaries and study retinal circulation autoregulation.
Blue-field entoptic measurements tracked retinal microvascular leukocyte recruitment in vivo and correlated with peripheral leukocyte count changes.

mechanistic_abstraction.core_law: A useful observer transform need not reconstruct the whole hidden state. It can suppress the dominant carrier and expose a sparse, independently interpretable witness set whose trajectories reveal structure.
mechanistic_abstraction.formal_sketch: Let X be a dense hidden state, B its dominant background component, W a sparse witness component, and T an observer transform. If contrast(T(W), T(B)) >> contrast(W, B), then W can become operationally detectable without reconstructing X in full.

mapping.retinal_dense_background: large combinatorial bulk / many locally unproductive candidates
mapping.bright_leukocyte_corpuscle: sparse candidate carrying a checkable conflict or strict-descent witness

direct_relevance_to_current_TRUMP.R46A: Compatible with the already-separated producer/verifier architecture: a faster or more selective producer may suggest candidates while the unchanged legacy replay remains proof authority.
direct_relevance_to_current_TRUMP.R46B: Strongest transfer target. The entoptic analogy says do not reconstruct or optimize the entire field if one sparse, certified progress witness is enough; search for the first independently certified descent.
direct_relevance_to_current_TRUMP.R46C: Second transfer target. Use truth-blind contrast features to rank candidates, but keep exhaustive fallback and never grant the ranker proof authority.
